whatHappens.value: Heavy raidwide (Forsaken), then 8 sets of 2 towers. After the cast, 2 players get a stack marker (always 1 tank/healer and 1 DPS), 3 get circle AoEs and 3 get cones; the circles all go to one group (tanks+healers or DPS) and the cones to the other. Each set's tower soakers trigger their markers and get new ones. Every second set comes with Past's/Future's End (baits on the 4 players nearest Kefka) and then All Things Ending (half-room cleaves from Kefka and his clones).

resolutionOrder.value: Forsaken raidwide → line-up → sets 1-3 (tower group) → swap → sets 4-7 (helpers) → swap → set 8 (tower group) → final bait at A → Light of Judgment. Past's/Future's End lands with each even set; All Things Ending resolves with sets 3, 5, 7 and after set 8.

whyItWorks.value: Pairs never change and each pair always works the same side (supports left, DPS right), so a glance at your partner's spell tells you your spot. The stack pairs and the others swap after set 3, giving everyone exactly 4 soaks before Light of Judgment. Fixed outside spots put the right players nearest Kefka for the Past's/Future's End baits, and waiting between or opposite the towers aims the clone cleaves away from the next towers.
